participants.note: raised concern about loading existing wallets and questioned benefits, but later clarified no objection
supported disallowing whitespace-only names on creation while allowing existing wallets to load
asked whether non-ASCII whitespace characters are handled
suggested disallowing leading and trailing whitespace on creation and updating the error message

claims.harm: pre-existing wallets with whitespace names might fail to be loaded, restored, or dumped
claims.quote: Seems highly risky, because it could mean that a pre-existing wallet name that is nested in whitespace could possibly not be loaded/restored/dumped/etc.
claims.settled_by_quote: Again, no objection. I am just curios what the real motivation here is.

claims.harm: wallet names with leading or trailing whitespace cause confusion or loading problems, and the empty-name error message is inaccurate
claims.quote: I think if we are doing this we should disable any white-space beginning or ending a wallet name.

support.reason: It's reasonable to disallow such names when creating a new wallet, but still allow existing wallets to be loaded.

result.notes: Recorded maflcko's resolved objection regarding loading existing wallets and polespinasa's open interface objection proposing to disallow leading/trailing whitespace. Achow101 is tracked as substantive support for disallowing whitespace-only names on wallet creation.
